description: The main dashboard at /app/dashboard serves as the inventory command center. It provides an at-a-glance view of stock health through 4 metric cards (Total SKUs, In Stock, Low Stock, Out of Stock) with counts and optional mini sparklines. Below that, a 'Needs Attention' section highlights items below reorder threshold, pending purchase orders, and overdue POs. A recent activity feed shows the last 20 stock movements with icons per type, timestamps, and item references. A quick search bar at the top lets users jump to any item. All data comes from the demo store hooks (useStockSummary, useRecentMovements, useItems). The layout is a responsive grid: 4 metric cards across on desktop, 2x2 on tablet, stacked on mobile.

stories.title: MetricCard shared component
stories.description: Create src/components/dashboard/MetricCard.tsx — a reusable card displaying a label, large number value (Geist Mono), optional trend indicator (up/down arrow with percentage), and optional status color accent (left border or dot). Props: label (string), value (number), trend ({ direction: 'up'|'down', percentage: number } | null), accentColor ('healthy'|'warning'|'danger'|'neutral'). Card uses surface background, 1px border, 6px radius per design system. Number renders in font-mono at 32px. Label in muted text at 14px.

Number uses Geist Mono at 32px
Label uses muted foreground at 14px
Trend arrow: green up or red down with percentage
accentColor applies left border or subtle tint

stories.title: Needs Attention section

Three sub-sections in a card: 1) 'Low Stock Items' — list of items at or below reorder threshold (show name, SKU, current qty, threshold, with amber StatusBadge), max 5 items with 'View All' link to /app/catalog?status=low. 2) 'Pending Orders' — count of POs in draft/submitted status with link to /app/purchase-orders. 3) 'Overdue Orders' — POs past expected delivery date (red highlight). stories.title: Dashboard quick search bar
stories.description: Add a search input at the top of the dashboard (below the page heading, above metric cards). Styled as a wide input with a Search icon and placeholder 'Search items by name, SKU, or barcode...'. On focus or typing, it filters items from useItems and shows a dropdown of up to 8 matching results. Clicking a result navigates to the item detail (stubbed as /app/catalog?item=ID for now). Pressing Escape or clicking outside closes the dropdown. This is a simpler version of the CMD+K palette — just for the dashboard.
